XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Fuel pressure sensor

  • Fault: Engine failure to start following a normal vehicle shutdown

  • Faults detected by self-diagnosis: P0651 (Reference Voltage Sensor 2 - Malfunction / Open)

  • Cause: Faulty fuel pressure sensor

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the fuel pressure sensor and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component in question is located on the fuel rail. Following its replacement, the problem was permanently resolved.
